symptoms: You will see many small spots on the leaves.
The spots have a pale brown center with a reddish brown border.
Similar spots can appear on the plant branches and pods.
Severe cases cause the leaves to fall off the plant.
On pods, the spots start as small water-soaked marks that grow larger.
These pod spots eventually become light brown, sunken, and rough.
favourable_conditions: High humidity, moist weather, and heavy rainstorms help the disease spread.
prevention: Plant your crop early as soon as the monsoon starts.
Use a bower system to keep the plants off the ground.
Make sure your field has good drainage to keep the soil from getting too wet.
practices: Check your fields regularly for signs of the disease.
Remove and destroy any plant parts that look sick.
Keep the field clean to stop the disease from spreading.
